meta.prompt: Compare two phone plans side by side for me: price, data, calls, roaming, contract length and extras, with the better value on each row marked, a recommendation at the bottom with one sentence of reasoning, and a choose button under each plan that tells you which I picked.
meta.text:
state pick=""
Card w:390 gap:12
  Text.title "Compare phone plans"
  Row gap:8
    Spacer w:84
    Column grow
      Text.strong "Lite"
    Column grow
      Text.strong "Plus"
  Divider
  Row gap:8 middle
    Text.muted "Price" w:84
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "$25/mo"
      Badge.success "Better value"
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "$40/mo"
  Divider
  Row gap:8 middle
    Text.muted "Data" w:84
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "10 GB"
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "Unlimited"
      Badge.success "Better value"
  Divider
  Row gap:8 middle
    Text.muted "Calls" w:84
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "300 min"
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "Unlimited"
      Badge.success "Better value"
  Divider
  Row gap:8 middle
    Text.muted "Roaming" w:84
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "None"
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "EU included"
      Badge.success "Better value"
  Divider
  Row gap:8 middle
    Text.muted "Contract" w:84
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "Monthly"
      Badge.success "Better value"
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "12 months"
  Divider
  Row gap:8 middle
    Text.muted "Extras" w:84
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "None"
    Column grow gap:4
      Text.strong "Streaming + cloud"
      Badge.success "Better value"
  Divider
  Row gap:8
    Spacer w:84
    Button.outline "Choose Lite" grow -> pick="Lite"; emit choose "Lite"; toast "You picked Lite"
    Button "Choose Plus" grow -> pick="Plus"; emit choose "Plus"; toast "You picked Plus"
  if pick!=""
    Text.success "You picked: {pick}"
  Divider
  Text.heading "Recommendation"
  Text "Plus wins on four of six rows, and for $15 more you get unlimited data and calls, roaming and extras, so it's the better value unless you need a flexible monthly contract."
